To make your life easier, you should get an Ore Prospector, it allows you to search and see what ores are close to you, and where. 

The first on is on us tho!

atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.chapter.title: Blood Magic
atm9e.quest.bmaddon.blood_generator.sub: Who needs a slate when you have a wall socket
atm9e.quest.bmaddon.blood_generator.desc:
Tired of stabbing yourself for every drop? The Blood Generator takes plain Forge Energy and turns it into Life Essence.

Feed it power, give it a place to put the essence, and let it work. Your health bar will thank you.

Tip: Run it off a steady power source. A machine that stalls halfway through an altar craft is more annoying than a few lost hearts.
atm9e.quest.bmaddon.blood_assembler.desc: The Blood Assembler is where your blood network meets your ME network. It crafts supported Blood Magic recipes straight from your ME system, so no more hand-feeding the altar.\n\nIt needs Life Essence to run, so connect it to a Blood Generator. Your ME system handles the rest.
atm9e.quest.bmaddon.blood_patterns.title: Blood on the Pattern
atm9e.quest.bmaddon.blood_patterns.desc:
The Assembler doesn't use ordinary Patterns. Blood Patterns are what tell it which recipe to make.

Put a blank Blood Pattern into the Pattern Encoding Terminal and encode a valid Blood Altar or Alchemy Table recipe. Then put the encoded pattern into the Assembler, and your ME network will offer that craft.

Alchemy Table recipes only work if they don't require a Blood Orb.
atm9e.quest.bmaddon.upgrades.title: Upgrade Your Obsession
atm9e.quest.bmaddon.upgrades.sub: Good enough was never the point.
atm9e.quest.bmaddon.upgrades.desc: A bare Blood Assembler is a start. Cards make it stronger.\n\nTier Cards unlock higher Blood Altar recipes. Parallel and Speed Cards make it faster. Pick the ones that match what you're automating.
atm9e.quest.bmaddon.tier2.title: Second Tier
atm9e.quest.bmaddon.tier2.desc: Tier II lets your Assembler handle Blood Altar recipes that need a Tier II altar. Insert the card and your patterns for those recipes will craft.
atm9e.quest.bmaddon.tier3.title: Third Tier
atm9e.quest.bmaddon.tier3.desc: The Assembler now covers recipes that need a Tier III altar.\n\nHigher tiers cost more Life Essence, so check your generators.
atm9e.quest.bmaddon.tier4.title: Fourth Tier
atm9e.quest.bmaddon.tier4.desc: Tier IV recipes are now in range. At this level, your generators should be running at full output.
atm9e.quest.bmaddon.tier5.title: Fifth Tier
atm9e.quest.bmaddon.tier5.desc: Tier V is the top card. The recipes it unlocks are some of the most demanding in Blood Magic, and the Assembler will take as much Life Essence as you can give it.
atm9e.quest.bmaddon.parallel_card.title: Parallelizing Everything
atm9e.quest.bmaddon.parallel_card.desc: The Parallel Processing Card lets the Assembler run several crafts at once. If you're making large batches of slates, orbs, or other altar products, this is the card to get.\n\nIt uses more Life Essence per cycle, so make sure your generators can keep up.
atm9e.quest.bmaddon.blood_speed_card.sub: Patience is a virtue. Efficiency is better.
atm9e.quest.bmaddon.blood_speed_card.des: The Blood Speed Card cuts the time each craft takes. It costs more Life Essence for the same output over time, but the speedup is worth it when you're in a hurry.\n\nPair it with a Parallel Processing Card if you want maximum throughput.
atm9e.quest.bmaddon.ae2_speed_card.title: Familiar Faces
atm9e.quest.bmaddon.ae2_speed_card.sub: Your old AE2 upgrades still work.
atm9e.quest.bmaddon.ae2_speed_card.desc: The Blood Assembler also accepts the standard AE2 Speed Card, so you can use the upgrades you already know.\n\nMix them with the Blood cards to tune the Assembler to your setup.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.airSigil.1: &9Air Sigil&r - Right Click to throw you in a direction you are facing for 50 LP.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.alchemicalCh: This is currently the only way to obtain &cWeak Blood Shards&r, which we'll need to upgrade our Altar.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.alchemyTable: The &9Alchemy Table&r can craft various objects, catalysts, and more by using LP from a player's Soul Network (aka using a Blood Orb).
This table can also convert many things, like Rotten Flesh to Leather, Wool to String, etc. It's pretty useful!
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.altarMobSacr: Now you can stab others to use their Blood instead!
Stabbing any mob within 2 blocks of your Altar with one of these will insta-kill them and drain their LP into your Altar!
If you have Runes of Sacrifice around your Altar, you'll get more per kill.
With our Alchemy Table and our Orb full of Blood, we want to make some &9Arcane Ashes&r.

With the Ashes, we'll be able to draw a circle on the ground, known as an Alchemy Array. You can insert 2 items in by right-clicking, and will either craft a new item or perform an action, like turning day into night!
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.bloodLamp.1: &cBlood Lamp&r - Launches a blood light when used. Costs 10LP
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.collectingDe: Before we can craft the &cHellfire Forge&r, we'll need a way to power it by acquiring &bDemon Will&r.
To start collecting it, we'll need to create some &dSoul Snares&r that we can use on mobs.
Once you use a few of these on a mob, white particles will appear around them. Slay them, and you'll acquire Demonic Will.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.demonRealmLo: Using loot from the Demon Realm, you can upgrade each rune to double its effect.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.demonWillSto: Hopefully by this point, you've been stocking up on some Demon Will with a Sentient Sword. If not, make sure to go and grab that part of the questline!
With our Saturated Tau and our Alchemical Reaction Chamber, we can make the required materials to upgrade our Altar and Blood Orb, the &4Weak Blood Shard&r.
This does require the Sanguine Reverter, which takes a couple of upgrades to your Tartaric Gem.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.demonicWillS: Demon Will stacks up very quickly in your inventory.
We're going to need a lot of it, so we'll need to create a way to store all of it. Creating a &9Tartaric Gem&r is just what we need.
The &bPetty Tartaric Gem&r is what we'll spend our first Demon Will on. This will store up to a maximum of 64 Will.
Note: If you drop any Demon Will you have in your inventory, the Gem will absorb it into its storage.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.divinationSi: 1) When you right-click with the Sigil in your hand, it will display the amount of LP you have in your Soul Network.
2) If you right-click a Blood Altar with it, you'll see how much LP is stored, the max it can store, and what tier the altar is.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.duskRitualDi: Now we'll need to make the Dusk version of the Ritual Diviner.
This gives us access to even more rituals, including the ritual that gets us to the Demon Realm.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.fruitThirsts: Just like everything in this pack, &cthe fruit thirsts for blood&r. Plant the fruit and force a mob on top of it.
It will drain the life force of the mob to become Saturated Tau.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.gettingStart: To get started with Blood Magic, we'll need to collect some blood.
To do this, we'll need to craft the &dSacrificial Knife&r and the &4Blood Altar&r.
Go ahead and place the Altar somewhere with plenty of space around it. We might want to expand on it more in the future.
To acquire blood, stand by the Altar and... well... use the knife. You'll take a little damage, but &oit's for the cause&r.
Each stab will generate around 200 LP.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.greenGroveSi: &2Green Gove Sigil&r - Right Clicking a crop that is growable will give it a bonemeal effect for 150LP. Shift-Right Clicking will consume 150LP per 5 seconds, increasing the growth rate of a 7x7x5 area.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.hellfireForg: The &4Hellfire Forge&r is one of the main blocks needed for creating certain items in Blood Magic.
It is powered by &dDemon Will&r, and can be used to create several items including the &bSentient Sword&r.
Once you make it to the Hidden Realm, you'll find a chest with some basic loot in it.
Keep an eye out for &9Iron Keys&r. These unlock the extra rooms within the Hidden Realm, giving access to even more loot.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.holding.1: &9Holding&r - Holds up to 5 other Sigils at a time, providing their passive effects and allowing you to activate them on a while. You can keybind buttons to access the inventory and cycle through the Sigils.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.imbuedSlates: Combing Reinforced Slate with some blood in our new Altar will give us Imbued Slates.
This is the next upgrade for our Blood Magic journey.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.infusingLife: We'll want to infuse Life Essence (aka LP or Blood) into some stone.
Placing stone in the Altar with 1000 LP inside will create Blank Slates. You'll need a lot of these.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.lavaSigil.1: With the Lava Sigil in hand, if you right-click, you'll create a source block of lava for the low low cost of 1,000 LP.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.livingEquipm: You can create Living Equipment by making some Binding Reagents in an Alchemy Table. You'll also need at least a Common Tartaric Gem in order to hold the Demon Will required.
&9Living Equipment&r is the equivalent in durability of Diamond Armor, and can be repaired in an Anvil using Binding Reagents.
It starts off as the equivalent of Iron, but has Upgrade Points that can be spent to train it in specific ways. It starts with 100, but there are ways to increase this limit.
As you use it, it will "learn" from you. You can see what it has learned so far by holding left shift while looking at it.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.magnetism.1: &6Magnetism&r - Activate for a magnet up to 7 blocks at the cost of 50LP every 5 seconds.
&aMiner's Sigil&r - Shift-Right Click to use 100LP per 5 seconds to give yourself a Haste buff.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.pathwayToEnd: Performing the &cPathway to the Endless Realm&r ritual will give you access to the proper Demon Realm.
This is the only place where you can find &9Demonite Ore&r. This is used to create the Tier 5 Altar.
There is also a ton of rare loot, so make sure to keep an eye out for Intricate Hellforged Parts.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.ritualDivine: While not required, the Ritual Diviner is great to have as it shows exactly how the Ritual is built, and helps build it. (You should totally make one.)
To build a ritual, shift-right click with the Ritual Diviner in the air until you find the ritual you want to create. You can shift-left click to go back as well.
Start by doing the Edge of the Hidden Realm ritual, as we'll need a few items from the dimension to get started.

Once selected with the Ritual Diviner, right click on a Master Ritual Stone until the structure is complete. You will need a bunch of Ritual Stones to perform these rituals. Once the structure is fully built, you can right click the Master Ritual Stone with a Weak Activation Crystal to activate it.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.ritualPrepar: With our Tier 3 Altar, we can start performing Rituals.
Rituals require a Master Ritual Stone and enough regular Ritual Stones to create.
Start by crafting a bunch of Ritual Stones as well as a Master Ritual Stone. These are the basic blocks we'll need to start doing rituals.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.seersSigil.1: &6Seer's Sigil&r - A better version of the Divination Sigil. Gives more info when looking at Altars.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.sentientSwor: We can't use Soul Snares forever.
The Sentient Sword allows you to collect Demon Will a lot easier. Simply kill a hostile mob with the sword, and the mob will drop Demon Will.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.suppressionS: &9Suppression Sigil&r - You can push liquids away from you in a 6 block radius. It's pretty cool.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.tauFruitUsag: Tau Fruit can be obtained from loot chests within the Hidden Realm. You'll need this to upgrade your Altar even further!
Once collected, the fruit can be planted to farm it. However, it has 2 potential products instead of one.
Growing the fruit naturally will result in more Tau Fruit, which can be turned into Oil. But what if we give it some blood......
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.teleposition: &6Teleposition Sigil&r - Will teleport the user to a linked Teleposer at the cost of 1000LP. You can shift-click with the sigil on a Teleposer to set the location.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.upgradeAltar: To upgrade our Altar to Tier 3, we need to get a lot more runes. 28 total to be exact.
You need to place 5 Blood Runes (Blank or better) one block down and two blocks away from the Tier 2 Altar runes, along each edge.
You'll then want to create a pillar in each corner out of any block, with a pillar cap of Glowstone sitting one block higher than the Altar itself.
If you want to check if the Altar was built correctly, use a &9Divination Sigil&r to check the Tier.
Note: Any non-air block can be used for the pillar, as long as the cap is Glowstone.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.upgradeJourn: With our Altar now at Tier 2, we can make even better Runes. We'll need some Reinforced slate to continue our journey in Blood Magic, including doing some Rituals.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.upgradingAlt: To craft even more items using blood, we'll want to upgrade our altar by surrounding it in &9Blank Runes&r.
If you want, you can replace the Blank Runes in each of the cardinal directions to runes like the &6Speed Rune&r. These runes can affect how the Altar functions.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.voidSigil.1: &cVoid Sigil&r - Right Click on any liquid to void it, costing 50 LP.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.waterSourceC: When held in hand, you can right-click to create a water source block for 100LP. Not bad huh?
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.weakBloodOrb: The &9Weak Blood Orb&r is used to store blood (or LP). It can be used as a way to transport blood to and from Altars. It also is used in several crafting recipes.
To craft this, you'll need to place a diamond on top of the Blood Altar, then generate enough LP to craft it.
To charge a Blood Orb, you can right-click to sacrifice some of your health to the Orb. This also links your Soul to your Soul Network. :)
You can also place the Orb in a Blood Altar that has some LP in it. It'll drain faster the more Speed Runes it has.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.welcome.2: This mod is all about using the Blood of your enemies (or yourself) to create powerful items and networks!
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.welcome.3: The guidebook contains all of the information about the mod if you ever need any help.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.willStorageU: An upgrade to our Will storage. This will hold a max of 256 Will.
This will hold a max of 1024 Will.
This is the maximum storage item for Demon Will, and will hold 4096 Will max.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.desc.gettingStart: IMPORTANT: blood will slowly drain from your altar, and make sure to read blood requirement!
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.blank_slate.title: Blank Slate
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.blank_slate.sub: You are going to want to batch craft
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.blank_slate_casin: Wondering how to Get the Materials?
If you are wondering how to get blood into your assembler, the easiest way is with evil craft. Craft a blood extractor and fill it with blood. Then in the assembler simply add it to the fluid.
If you are also confused on Umbral Steel, look for the hot ingot in the ebf
- The dust requires steel and crushed dark gem from evil craft
Highly recommend crafting multiple. YOU WILL NEED THEM
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.rune_casings.desc: To get Blank Runes to upgrade our altar from tier 1 to tier 2, you will first need rune casing
You will need pneumatic craft stone and manasteel.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.runes.title: Runes
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.runes.desc1: With blank runes, you can craft any of the other rune types (not reinforced though). All you need is some magic from other mods, and a lv assembler
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.coolingIngots.des: Need to cool energetic alloy or soularium, look at their hot blazing forms
Definitely won't allow you to skip some progression. Shhhh
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.tier_1_sigils.des: The Divination Sigil has two primatry uses:
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.virtualsacrificer: Tired of sacrificing creatures in world, well let me present to you the virtual sacrificer.
Look at JEI recipes for what to give it
The 4 pillars require this block on top for the tier 4 blood altar
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.gregmultis.title: Gregtech Multiblocks
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.gregmultis.desc1: These are the casings needed for blood magic multis
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.sanguine_feeder.t: Useful for your blood transferring needs
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.sanguine_feeder.d: Useful for your blood transferring needs
The Sanguine feeder can input any form of blood: solid or liquid, and can ouput one of three types of blood: life essence (Blood Magic), blood (Evilcraft), or sanguine concentrate (gtceu).
To link use a linking tool
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.sanguine_synth.de: An all in one Blood Magic Multi. Why use a forge or an alchemy table. Those are so last year...
Simply input will or blood and whatever items for the recipe.
DON'T FORGET TO SELECT MACHINE TYPE: Sanguine Synthesis, Sanguine Alchemy, Sanguine Forge, Sanguine Array, and Sanguine Reaction Chamber.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.will_feeder.title: Will Feeder
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.will_feeder.desc2: Same as the sanguine feeder, except with will.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.will_feeder.desc3: Will input hatches can accept tartaric gems (will not consume the gem, just the will) and demonic crystals. The output hatch can ouptut any type of will, and the bus can output any type of solid will.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.will_feeder.desc4: Types of will: raw, corrosive, destructive, vengeful, and steadfast
Tier 5 block, this time no pillars
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.dungeon_key.title: Dungeon Key
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.hellforged_ingots: A lot of recipes require some form of hellforge ingots, so make a lot
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.unlocking_bees.de: A lot of productive bees is gated behind blood magic. But hey if you are at this quest, then you can now make all that stuff.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.sanguine_ritual.d: Automated Blood Altar, for all your automation needs. Using the Sanguine Feeder you can input all the blood needed.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.blood_magic_hatch: Gregtech now has blood magic multis, and with that blood hatches. Blood input hatches accept all types of blood, solid or liquid, and can ouput one of three types of blood: life essence (Blood Magic), blood (Evilcraft), or sanguine concentrate (gtceu).

Will input hatches can accept tartaric gems (will not consume the gem, just the will) and demonic crystals. The output hatch can ouptut any type of will, and the bus can output any type of solid will.
Types of will: raw, corrosive, destructive, vengeful, and steadfast
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.gtmachines.title: Gregtech x Blood Magic Machines
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.gtmachines.desc1: Sanguine Forge is a single block machine Hellfire forge
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.gtmachines.desc2: Sanguine Alchemy is a single block machine alchemy table
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.gtmachines.desc3: Sanguine Arc Furnace, as you may have picked up by now is the single block machine for the arc furnace
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.gtmachines.desc4: Sanguine Array is the machine for recipes you normally have to make with arcane ashes
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.gtmachines.desc5: All of these machines will later be replaced with the Sanguine Synthesizer Multi
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.gtmachines.desc6: TIP: to get blood into machines simple import liquid blood. HINT: Evilcraft has very simple ways of getting liquid blood
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.gtmachines.desc7: TIP 2: Simple Fluid extract will for liquid will
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.sanguine_refinery: The Sanguine Refinery has one purpose, turn blood from either evilcraft or blood magic, and turn it into sanguine concrete.
Which is used in many recipes
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.obtaining_will_cr: You will need a lot of will in this pack. Crystals are a good source for all that will.

Demon Crucible: Simply put in a charged tartaric gem or any aspect of demon will or demon crystal. As needed the will will slowly be consumed to make demon aura. Some rituals may need the will aura, the main benefit is the ability to create demon will crystals.
NOTE: aura is chunk based, if you wish to move it around craft a demon pylon or multiple:

Demon Crystallizer: Will slowly consume the aura to produce will crystals. First cost is 100 will and the subsequent spires cost 45 will each. Largest crystal cluster can be up to 7 spires. If you have more than 512 total will in your inventory you can harvest the crystal (right click), will remove all but the central spire.
NOTE: there is an easier way to get the demon crystals via ritual of the Resonance of the Faceted Crystal
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.demon_will.desc1: Breaks apart a well grown Raw crystal cluster into separately aspected crystal clusters.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.demon_will.desc3: Spire must be at least 5, and will turn it into each aspected will crystal cluster on the four element ritual stones. Please consult the book for setup.
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.hatchlink.title: Hatch Link Tool
atm9e.quest.bloodmagic.hatchlink.desc1: Used for linking the feeder's too where they need to go
